content.comment_body: I'm working with [product_name] for the first time. Is it possible to simulate an input signal using [product_name] engineering software? I need this for testing purposes. I know it's possible on [version_no].

Hello, You can use a hardware wire bridge to achieve this. Forcing inputs directly within [product_name] isn't supported, except in simulation mode, which is quite useful for testing your program. Regards,
It's a simple method, but effective.
Good suggestion, [user_name]! This tip could be valuable for me in certain situations in the future. Thanks for sharing. Regards.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are seeking a way to simulate or force input signals through [product_name] engineering software to facilitate testing, similar to functionality available on [version_no] devices. The discussion confirms that direct input forcing is only available in simulation mode; hardware solutions like wire bridges are suggested instead. Although simulation mode helps with testing logic, the limitation of not being able to force real inputs is noted.
analysis.user_expectations: Users wish to force input signals using software for convenient testing, similar to what is possible with [version_no] series devices.
